''See also: [[Larian Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Larian is a renowned archer representing the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]]. Raised in a noble household, she achieved [[Gold]] rank at the age of six, and her combat prowess is such that a massive army of [[Gold]]-ranked [[sacred artists]] would be unable to penetrate her armor. She utilizes a specialized bow that resembles twisted gray driftwood and is capable of utilizing techniques such as Long-Sight. While she often adopts a casual, humorous, or even theatrical persona, she is also capable of assuming the status of a [[Monarch]] by drawing power from her comrades. As a participant in events involving [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], Larian has expressed a desire to challenge the existing system maintained by [[Monarchs]]. She is known for her bluntness and her tendency to act without a rigid plan, prioritizing change over stability. Throughout her experiences, she has interacted with various powerful figures, including [[Lindon]] and [[Northstrider]], often displaying a mix of camaraderie and sharp-witted defiance.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Larian is a blonde woman who wears bright golden armor. Her armor has been seen cracked and emitting spiritual essence, and she carries a bow made of gray driftwood.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Larian is connected to [[Lindon]], who is the person she appears beside. [[Dross]] is an individual who threatened to haunt Larian if [[Lindon]] provided her with the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s [[binding]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A renowned archer, she possesses the [[Bow of the Silent King]] and has the skill to forge white arrows. She utilizes sharp perception and can draw power to become a [[Monarch]] of [[The Empire|the Empire]].}}
